step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents a integration between Salesforce (SFDC) and AWS using PrivateLink. Control Plane (Flow 0): User accesses SFDC UI, sending requests to API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, and establishing PrivateLink endpoints with SNS notifications. Data Plane (Flow 1): Encrypted VPN traffic flows from SFDC to Transit Gateway, routed through EKS containers to the Transit VPC PrivateLink, connecting to Customer VPC PrivateLink.

graph.name: Salesforce Private Connect Integration with AWS
graph.notes: Shows control plane setup and data plane traffic flow between Salesforce and Customer VPC via PrivateLink.

nodes.name: Transit Gateway

edges.notes: User enters PrivateLink setup details in Salesforce UI.
Control plane setup request sent to API Gateway.
Lambda stores customer connection metadata in DynamoDB.
Lambda provisions PrivateLink connection in Transit VPC.
PrivateLink state changes trigger SNS notifications.
Customer data sent via site-to-site encrypted VPN tunnel.
Transit Gateway forwards traffic to EKS connection forwarders.
Forwarder routes data to appropriate PrivateLink based on metadata.
Data transmitted across PrivateLink connection to Customer VPC.
